objective: Connect the versioned application settings store to the API and workbench UI so appearance preferences persist server-side across browsers and sessions.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Issue #158 application/core boundary: user preferences must not mutate scientific model artifacts or validation state.
PR #166 merged versioned atomic JSON settings store.
PR #161 established local-data ingestion and provenance boundaries.
Lifecycle gate requires machine-readable records with only supported metric names.

baseline.status: Settings store exists but is not yet exposed through the API or consumed by the workbench.

expected_improvement: Expose a validated GET/PUT settings contract at /v1/settings.
Persist settings outside the repository by default and allow explicit ZTF_API_STATE_PATH override.
Load and save theme and day/night appearance preferences through the API with localStorage fallback when API persistence is unavailable.
Cover persistence and validation with API tests while preserving scientific boundary.

correctness.before: Settings store had no HTTP contract or UI integration.
correctness.after: GET/PUT contract and focused API test cover defaults, persistence, invalid values, and preservation of previous valid state.

reliability.after: Preferences use atomic server-side JSON persistence when the API is available; localStorage is retained as offline fallback.

scientific_validity.before: Application state store was isolated but not connected to the product.
scientific_validity.after: Only application preference routes and UI wiring are added; scientific model artifacts and release gate are untouched.

evidence: Awaiting CI, CodeQL, Product Scope Audit, and lifecycle validation for this PR head.

root_causes: The previous settings store was not wired to API routes or workbench controls.
The UI used localStorage only, so preferences were not shared with server-side application state.

findings: Keep user preferences in the application-state store and never use them to configure or override scientific model artifacts.
Keep localStorage as a degraded/offline fallback while server-side API persistence is the preferred source.
Validate theme and time strings before atomic persistence; invalid updates must not replace the last valid state.

open_blockers: Run full CI and required PR checks on the final commit before merge.
Confirm test coverage and static audit are green.

knowledge_carried_forward: Application settings are non-scientific state and must not bypass validation or model artifact integrity.
Do not merge while required checks are pending or failing.
